title: Jellyfish holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>

  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 30 Q68 40 60 50 Q52 58 55 63' stroke='#ffdd55' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M68 58 Q72 70 67 80 Q64 86 69 92' stroke='#ff77c8' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- jellyfish bell -->
  <path d='M28 58 Q26 40 32 30 Q40 20 50 20 Q60 20 68 30 Q74 40 72 58 Q66 52 60 58 Q54 52 48 58 Q42 52 36 58 Q34 54 28 58 Z' fill='url(#bell)'/>

  <!-- bell rim highlight -->
